d: Then we go a layer deeper. How Blinkit, Zepto, and Instamart turned shopping into a five-minute mission. Why the real profit pool in 10-minute delivery is advertising, projected to cross ₹28,000 crore in 2026. And how AI assistants like ChatGPT and Flipkart's Flippi are digitising the way India has always shopped, by asking someone before buying. Indian e-commerce is headed from 65 billion dollars to 170 to 180 billion by 2030, and most of that growth comes from an India that doesn't show up on your timeline. If you're building, selling, or investing here, this is the India you can't…
